entities.summary: Michał Franciszek Karpowicz was a professor of the Vilnius University, participant of the Kościuszko Uprising (1794), and Roman Catholic bishop of the diocese of Wigry. Karpowicz is regarded as the most famous preacher of the Age of Enlightenment in Lithuania and the Polish–Lithuanian Commonwealth. He delivered sermons for ~20 years to the noble participants of the sessions of the Lithuanian Tribunal. His ancestors were Lithuanian nobles which are known since the 15th century.
